author: Mike Kasberg
units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.

mapping.baseSocket: Measured 4.50 length retained; width = sheet + proposed .10–.30 total allowance
mapping.spineTongue: 4.50 minus allowance length, sheet thickness and sheet-deep reach
mapping.terraceSlots: Original lengths = next narrower spine width + allowance; widths = sheet + allowance
mapping.shoulders: Original five-step spine, widths = lower contour span × .70/.55/.40/.25, then measured 4.50; steps at 6–12 mm equal elevation intervals
mapping.carrier: Original six-bay card and 24 bed-level .4–.6 mm runners; snips avoid slots, shoulder interfaces and tongue
mapping.personalization: Protected front plinth recess, actual Boolean height-field or source mesh cutter; no source triangles

differences: Original six-part abstract contour landscape, four horizontal plates lowered over a narrowing vertical spine. Not a spacecraft, repeated dock mechanism, imported geographic terrain or reproduction of reference art. Slots and shoulders need calibrated adhesive joints; no physical testing.
